query: ALTER TABLE deployment_environment_variable ADD CONSTRAINT deployment_environment_variable_fk_deployment_id_workspace_id FOREIGN KEY(deployment_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES deployment(id, workspace_id), ADD CONSTRAINT deployment_environment_variable_fk_secret_id_workspace_id FOREIGN KEY(secret_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES secret(id, workspace_id), ADD CONSTRAINT deployment_env_var_chk_value_secret_id_either_not_null CHECK((value IS NOT NULL AND secret_id IS NULL) OR (value IS NULL AND secret_id IS NOT NULL));
